hero.slide1Body: Direct farmer-to-door fresh produce, verified local motorbikes, Batkhela highway plots, and regional livestock with instant WhatsApp contact and zero mediator fees.
hero.slide2Body: Explore hundreds of verified wholesale and retail deals straight from Batkhela Main Road, Dargai electronics row, and Sakhakot textile centers.
hero.slide3Eyebrow: High Alpine Agriculture & Clean Solar Power
hero.slide3Body: Heavy-duty 15kW tube-well inverters, high-yield Sahiwal dairy cattle, and 100% natural Totakan mountain honey directly from verified local families.
hero.slide4Body: From terraced hillside farms to pine-covered slopes, discover produce and goods sourced straight from Malakand's green countryside.
hero.slide5Body: Sweet, juicy Malta oranges grown in Palai's orchards — a Malakand specialty available fresh, direct from local growers.
hero.slide6Body: From the bustling city center to the calm of Batkhela Lake, connect with sellers across the heart of Malakand's commercial hub.
